sculksight.config.title: Sculk Sight
sculksight.config.shell_opacity.tooltip: How solid the detection shell looks. The see-through pass follows this at a fixed proportion, so one slider moves both.
sculksight.config.render_policy.tooltip: Multi-sensor rendering: draw selected sensors as one merged shape (Union), or one coloured shell per sensor (Split).
sculksight.config.see_through_inside.too: How strongly the see-through pass draws while you are inside the shell. Full keeps today's look; Weak dims it so the blocks around you stay readable; Off skips it, leaving only the depth-tested faces you have line of sight to.
sculksight.config.global_render.tooltip: Global render: turn all sensor shell rendering on or off at once, without changing which sensors are tracked or their individual Enabled toggles below. Same as pressing G.
sculksight.config.delay_overlay.tooltip: Delay overlay: show or hide the per-block travel-delay numbers over every tracked sensor whose own delay-overlay checkbox (in its Options screen) is on. Same as pressing H. Has no effect until at least one such sensor is being rendered.
sculksight.config.detection_indicator.to: Detection indicator: report in chat whenever you enter or leave a tracked sensor's detection range. Independent of the shell above. Same as pressing J.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.name: %s (%s, %s, %s)
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.enable: Toggle whether this sensor's shell is rendered.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.remove: Remove this sensor from the tracked-render list immediately.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.delete: Remove every tracked sensor from the list immediately. Does not affect a live find in progress.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.option: Open this sensor's name, enabled and delay-overlay controls.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.rename: Apply this name to the sensor.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.delay_: Show this sensor's per-block travel-delay numbers whenever the delay overlay (H) is on.
sculksight.config.audit_sensors.empty: No sensors in range from where you are standing.
sculksight.config.audit_sensors.shown.to: Show or hide this found sensor's shell. A live find saves nothing, so this lasts until you pin it, run another find, run '/sculksight find off', or leave the world.
sculksight.config.audit_sensors.pin.tool: Add every sensor this live find selected to the tracked sensors above, where they are saved and keep their own Options and Remove controls. This ends the live find, so the shells stop following you. Same result as running the find with 'static'.
sculksight.command.find.live: Live find: %s. The shells follow you until you leave the world or run another find.
sculksight.command.find.cap_reached: Cap reached: %s sensors matched, showing the nearest %s.
sculksight.command.find.detector.unknown: Unknown detector type '%s'. Expected one of %s.
sculksight.command.find.radius.out_of_ra: Radius %s is out of range. Expected %s to %s blocks.
sculksight.command.find.usage: Radius and mode are required for a find, e.g. /sculksight find <type> <radius> <static|live>. Use /sculksight find off with nothing else to cancel a live find.
sculksight.command.pin.rejected_cap: ; %s did not fit the tracked limit of %s
sculksight.chat.detection.entered: you are now within a sensor's detection range.
sculksight.chat.detection.left: you are no longer within any sensor's detection range.
sculksight.chat.activate.no_listener: the targeted block at %s has no game event listener.
sculksight.chat.activate.not_detector: the targeted block at %s is not a detector.
sculksight.chat.activate.limit_reached: the tracked sensor limit is %s, so the sensor at %s was not tracked.
